title: Proposed study collaboration on neurofibromatosis type 1

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on neurofibromatosis type 1
Dear Children's Tumor Foundation team, you support people living with neurofibromatosis type 1.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work links NF1 to loss of function: losing neurofibromin leaves RAS switched on.
Your NF Registry and the NF Registry Portal include people with NF1, and a natural history study is active but not recruiting.
Selumetinib and mirdametinib are approved for plexiform neurofibromas, though selumetinib showed no significant adult quality-of-life difference.
Statins and tipifarnib did not show benefit in randomised trials in NF1.
We would propose [study aim and design], built with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your registry or community could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a convenient time?
